column1: # The C2a evidence-API retirement ledger - the committed enumeration the
# programme plan (section C2a, rev-5 R5-1) requires: every candidate site the
# committed nets in scripts/ci/evidence-api-ledger.py find, classified.
# Key = (file, kind, whitespace-normalised snippet); count = live occurrences.
# Line numbers are deliberately NOT recorded (drift); --list prints them live.
# Classes: PROBE (recovers a semantic fact from an emitted artifact - the
# retirement population), PROPAGATION (refs carried by construction -
# KEPT-BY-CLASS, never burn-down debt), EXCLUDED (the net matched but no
# emitted-artifact evidence is read; note names the reason).
# Tie-break used at classification (recorded per plan section C2a): where a
# string test on rendered text was genuinely borderline the row went to PROBE,
# never to EXCLUDED - overcounting probes only adds census work; undercounting
# Dispositions: PENDING until C2c/C2d disposition each probe RETIRED (row
# deleted + pin moved in the same commit) or JUSTIFIED-KEPT (note carries the
# justification). The pin below is EXACT against the live tree.
# NET-ZERO MOVEMENT at seat-32 law D.3, recorded because a row-for-row swap under an
#   unchanged pin is what this freeze exists to surface: the #356 re-wrap gate's
#   condition was rewritten, so its PROBE row's snippet moved (`if (arg.endsWith(
#   (ctorSetterValueSeat || listLitCollapse)`) and the newline half split out as its
#   OWN row, EXCLUDED under the same note as its #387 sibling.  -1 PROBE +1 PROBE
#   +1 EXCLUDED = 182 unchanged; no probe was retired or justified-kept.

THE GOVERNANCE INVERSION: TWENTY-FOUR of the 43 rows (55.8%) change verdict against the triage table, and the direction is the reverse of the table's - EVERY ONE of the family's twenty RETIRE-AFTER-CENSUS rows moves to JUSTIFIED-KEPT, and all four retirements come from the JUSTIFIED-KEPT-CANDIDATE side. The twenty RAC rows were verdicted on PROPOSED channels (a chain-top window, a cardinality computer, a workspace inference, a recorded restructure, a recorded hoist kind, a producer-set session flag, an AST spine walk, an AST base/step test) and the census finds every one of those eight unpopulated, unreachable, non-existent or measurably wrong, seat by seat, with the figure at each. A family can close mostly KEPT and that is a RESULT. THE CENSUS FIRST (round c9 at e81fc62e2, probes applied then reverted, never committed): the default-route D11 275/0F and 506,934 probe lines, the IR-route D11 275/0F and 439,980, the optimised suite 12/0F and 483,255 - 1,430,169 lines parsed, 0 ignored / 0 malformed / 0 spliced / 0 probeExc / 0 parse-reject on every walk, 41 tags per walk of the 43 in the schema (S11 and S12 have zero arrivals anywhere). THE FOUR RETIREMENTS are all drained-chain TAIL reads deleted because the AST conjunct beside each already decides: S22's ladder rung, where isThenChainTerminalCtor TRUE IMPLIES the render ends .build() at 15/15 with ZERO counterexamples in 17,361 arrivals and the 249 converse failures all carry ctorArm=true (the disjunct above already fires); its two clause-for-clause LAW-69 mirrors S21 and S19, where both sides are false at 1,146/1,146 and 486/486 so the two agree everywhere - kept as RETIREMENTS onto the predicate rather than deletions, because the predicate is live (negating S21's moves 50 terminal arms on EACH D11 walk and 37 on the optimised walk, 137 combined) and the #615 'not DEAD, mirror' adjudication applies; and S20's #396 CR-terminal filter-predicate arm, the family's strongest single measurement at 122,731/122,731 (36 positives, 122,695 negatives, zero off-diagonal on any walk) - a bijection with a MECHANISM behind it, since the .asMapper() tail is appended by the CR-terminal chain's own re-root, which the SAME predicate admits - stated that way and not as 'ONE event', because the producer gates the re-root on !hasSink AND isInsideEnclosingLambda with this predicate as one disjunct of three: isInsideEnclosingLambda is implied by the consumer's own FILTER_PREDICATE guard, and !hasSink is the residual that the zero off-diagonal answers empirically rather than structurally. THE THREE MASTER NEGATIVES, each of which killed a proposed retirement: (1) the #350 binding and the #356 chain-top window are in NO containment relation - the window is a strict SUBSET at S01 (3/126), a strict SUPERSET at S02 (789 F/T), answers NEVER at S13 (0/180) and disagrees in BOTH directions at S14 (525 T/F + 342 F/T with no arrival where both answer false); (2) the one-producer .then( retirement is unbuildable as specified - the single producer has sessionReachable=false at 117/117 firings, so the session flag cannot be set where it runs, and the four consumers are inert anyway at 61,985 arrivals with ZERO residues; (3) the HOISTREG 'recorded kind' agreement of 2,886/2,886 is a SELF-agreement - the probe sits inside registerStatementHoist(String), receives only a String and recomputes the same four string tests the pull site runs, so it measures string stability across the drain and says nothing about a typed channel (the #614 law: the instrument can be the defect), and a second round with the probe at the registerStatementHoist CALL SITES is required before any future HOIST seat. THE TRIAGE'S STATED JUSTIFICATIONS WERE REFUTED at three further rows: S26's '#339 two channels disagree by design' is UNPOPULATED (boundKind == compiledKind at 45/45), S36's 'rung 2 dormant until rung 1 lands' is REFUTED (63 reads, 21 per walk), and S39's 'opaque __STMT_HOIST_N__ sentinel, collision-free by construction' is REFUTED (nameIsSentinel=false at 174 of 2,610, 6.67%). A triage JUSTIFICATION is a hypothesis exactly as a triage VERDICT is.
